title: Last Lover
original_title: Last Lover ラストラバー
overview: Miyu loses her boyfriend, Mitsuki, in a truck accident. While grieving, strange phenomena begin to occur around her, and soon a colleague is murdered. Concerned about the series of deaths, she confides in her senior colleague, Konishi, and gradually finds herself drawn to him. But one day, Mitsuki suddenly reappears…
